Guthrie County's Oldest Citizen
Centenarian Receives A
Big Ovation.

Last Saturday the oitizens of Guthrie
Center almost to a unit turned out to
bestow their congratulations on Mr.
Martholomew Dunley who celebrated
his one hundredth birthday anniversary
on that day. All business housss
were closed on proclamation of Mayor
Holsman and all did honor to the occasion.
Guthrie County will soon
have another Centenarian, Mr. Lewis
of Menlo whose next birthday we are
informed will be his one hundredth on
which occasion Menlo will be right to
the front in observing.
